en: When the harmony of the city{SAUT}is disturbed...
Kamoshidaman is justice incarnate,{SAUT}and justice itself is Kamoshidaman!
This is a perfect society: justice{SAUT}rules, and must be obeyed by all...
However, a wicked miscreant voices{SAUT}discontent for our shining salvation!
Defying the hero of justice{SAUT}is unforgivable!
Can Kamoshidaman defeat the evil{SAUT}that opposes righteousness?
